context: Task preferred a justfile-owned 'bunx --bun commitlint@<pin>' to avoid touching package.json. Empirically falsified in worktree: bunx cannot co-install @commitlint/cli and @commitlint/config-conventional (-p does not compose multiple packages), and commitlint resolves config-conventional extends from the repository root module tree, so plain bunx fails with 'Cannot find module @commitlint/config-conventional'. commitlint.config.ts must stay byte-identical (CTX-0004 review), so extends cannot be inlined.
decision_body: Pin @commitlint/cli@21.2.2 and @commitlint/config-conventional@21.2.2 as exact devDependencies (plus markdownlint-cli2@0.23.1), consistent with this repo's established JS pin home (package.json + bun.lock, like prettier/wrangler). The justfile owns the GATES (commit-lint, markdownlint, fmt-check-files targets); hooks never invoke tools directly. lefthook itself stays out of dependencies: hooks-install target fetches pinned lefthook@2.1.10 via bunx --bun. package.json/bun.lock changes are called out in the PR and report per task authorization.
title: CTX-0005: commitlint runtime uses exact devDependency pins, not standalone bunx pin

consequences: bitty-website docs mirror sync is deferred until the canonical source merges; site path-drift fixes proceed independently.

decision_body: Wait for the #249 merge, then pin the merge commit with just docs-sync and complete the sync in the same PR; do not pin PR head 9dde0ab1.
title: CTX-0022 docs sync depends on bitty-docs PR #249 merge
